name: spectralflux
expr: y2 = spectralFlux(S4, F4); y1 = spectralFlux(S4, F4, 'NormType', 1); yic = spectralFlux(S4, F4, zeros(4,1)); [yf, fc] = spectralFlux(S4, F4); ycx = spectralFlux(complex(S4, 1), F4); ysgl = spectralFlux(single(S4), single(F4)); yt = spectralFlux(xc, 1600); ym = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'SpectrumType', 'magnitude'); yfft = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'FFTLength', 128); yovl = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'OverlapLength', 10); ywin = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'Window', hann(64)); ywinovl = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'Window', rectwin(32), 'OverlapLength', 16); yrng = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'Range', [100 700]); ycomb = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'Window', hann(48), 'OverlapLength', 24, 'FFTLength', 128, 'Range', [200 600]); xmc = [xc, xc.*0.5+0.25]; ymc = spectralFlux(xmc, 1600); ymagp = spectralFlux(xc, 1600, 'SpectrumType', 'mag'); ysml = spectralFlux((1:2)', 1600); ym3 = spectralFlux([1 2 3;4 5 6], 1600);
comment: Sig: flux = spectralFlux(x, f[, initialCondition][, Name=Value]) / [flux, finalCondition] = spectralFlux(...). Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: NormType NV in {1,2} (the old positional-p form removed - a 3rd positional is initialCondition, M×1); SpectrumType 'power'/'magnitude'; freq form takes complex X (|X_t - X_{t-1}| inside) with real F matching rows(X); time form is double/single real column with the probed default STFT window (64/32 pinned while round(0.03·fs) < 128 - frame counts cross-checked on fs 400..8000); magnitude normalization |Y|/(sum(win)/2). Deferred (stub, bugs/opened/audio/spectral-flux-stft-options.md): Window/OverlapLength/FFTLength/Range; multichannel time-form (bugs/opened/audio/spectral-flux-multichannel-time-form.md). 2026-09-18: the four STFT options landed (exact signal.internal.spectraldescriptors port; OverlapLength-only uses the fix((xLen+7ovl)/8) '8 segments' window); multichannel time form (columns are channels, FxC out); SpectrumType validatestring prefixes; short signals get min(64,xLen) windows. Values bit-match probe60/61.
